title: Orbit — five AI agents that review every pull request
description: A light, spring-animated landing page for an AI code review product. Five agents (tests, security, performance, style, docs) orbit a pull request card; drag the ring to spin it and whichever agent lands in front reports its finding. A five-step pinned story, an inline-commented diff, a config panel, a 3D review calendar and per-seat pricing follow.
features: Spinnable agent ring with inertia and spring snap, driven by one motion value
Agents pass behind and in front of the pull request card
Five agent visuals: test writer, hold-to-override, latency budget ruler, style switches, docs diff
Unified diff with inline agent comments that keeps indentation
Liquid dial for answering a comment
